description: This file is a C header file that declares utility functions for the RDK logger environment, including getting environment variables, adding configuration files, and other utility functions related to logging configuration.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGet
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variable value with the specified name.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGetNum
methods.description: Retrieves a numerical identifier associated with a module for logging purposes.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGetValueFromNum
methods.description: Gets the environment variable value associated with a given module number.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGetModFromNum
methods.description: Returns the module name corresponding to a given module number.

methods.name: rdk_logger_env_add_conf_file
methods.description: Adds a configuration file for the logger environment from the specified path.
